skill:skills/zephyr-core/SKILL.md.reason: Narrowed zephyr-core to platform workflows (versions, tags, environments, promotion, rollback, public overrides). Removed sdk-setup.md and examples-resume.md and every pointer to the retired federation skill; SDK setup now routes to the installed package's bundled skills.
evidence: No remaining reference in the repository links to sdk-setup.md, examples-resume.md, or the retired skill directory.
Intent validation passes for the remaining skill; all four distribution manifests list only ./skills/zephyr-core and the native plugin versions are 1.1.0.
Fresh-agent selection and native plugin update behavior remain unverified.

skill:skills/zephyr-module-federation/SK.reason: Preserved the existing skill instructions and activation description as purpose; added a domain and local reference provenance, without rewriting SDK API guidance or promising cross-repository freshness.
evidence: The existing skill body and reference files are unchanged; frontmatter is additive.
Both selected directories and sibling links are retained in the repository exports.
Intent 0.5.0 validation passes; actionlint accepts the read-only SHA-pinned workflow.
Fresh-agent discovery, native host activation/update/removal, and live deployments are not tested in this adoption.

planning:skills/_artifacts.head: 0dc383b7af4e4948b8823e4233a684b049067582
planning:skills/_artifacts.reason: Recorded the retirement and platform-only scope in skill_spec.md, removed the federation skill, domain, and cross-references from domain_map.yaml, and opened a gap for the zephyr-core name shared with the packaged guide.
evidence: Intent maintainer sync reports no drift and zero authoring issues.
README Skills table lists only zephyr-core and points SDK and federation questions to installed packages.
